classes.name: Healer
classes.role: Kind, wise team helper. Uses divine or nature magic.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.role: Smart ranged spellcaster with big magical moments.

paths.name: Druid
paths.blurb: Forest mage of animals and elements.

paths.name: Dragon Guard
paths.blurb: Fire-magic warrior with sword, armor, and spells.

abilities.name: Brave Heart
abilities.text: Never affected by fear.

abilities.name: Shield
abilities.text: Block all damage from one attack on you or a friend next to you.

abilities.name: Finishing Blow
abilities.text: Hit a Hurt, Stuck, or Frightened monster for +3 damage. Once per fight, this also works on a monster below half HP.

abilities.name: Champion's Strike
abilities.text: Once per fight, your hit deals max weapon damage + Might. Add Finishing Blow if it applies.

abilities.name: Executioner
abilities.text: Enemies at half HP or less take +5 from Finishing Blow. Once per fight, dropping a monster to 0 HP gives a free sword swing at another nearby monster.

abilities.name: I Take It
abilities.text: When a friend next to you is hit, take the hit instead for half damage.

abilities.name: Unbreakable
abilities.text: Shield works twice per fight. I Take It now also heals the protected friend or yourself 2 HP.

abilities.name: Last Stand
abilities.text: Once per adventure, when you would drop to 0 HP, stay at 1 HP. Your next attack auto-hits and deals double damage. If it drops the enemy, a friend or you heal d6 HP.

abilities.name: Battle Cry
abilities.text: Once per fight, shout your battle cry as a free action. Friends within sight get +2 to their next attack roll and +2 damage.

abilities.name: Banner Bearer
abilities.text: Once per adventure, plant your sword. Friends within sight heal d6 + Might HP and lose Hurt, Stuck, and Frightened. Battle Cry resets and you choose an enemy to Frighten.

abilities.name: Warlord's Eye
abilities.text: Once per fight, add +5 to hit for any ally rolling (even if the roll failed) plus max damage.

abilities.name: Sharp Eyes
abilities.text: +2 Mind when searching.

abilities.name: Sneak Attack
abilities.text: +1 damage from hiding.

abilities.name: Hide
abilities.text: Roll d20 + Speed, beat 13 to become Hidden.

abilities.name: Silent Step
abilities.text: Your Hide only needs 10 or more instead of 13 — easier than other Scouts.

abilities.name: Vanish
abilities.text: Once per fight, become Hidden as a free action. Hidden gets +2 extra damage (+3 total). After attacking, roll d20 + Speed; 10+ means you stay Hidden.

abilities.name: Ghost Strike
abilities.text: If not hidden, you Vanish. Ghost Strike keeps you Hidden with no roll needed. Hidden attack bonus becomes +4.

abilities.name: Shadowstep
abilities.text: Once per fight, vanish and reappear anywhere within sight.

abilities.name: Perfect Shot
abilities.text: Once per fight, auto-hit with no roll needed. +2 damage plus Stuck or Hurt (you choose).

abilities.name: Hawk Eye
abilities.text: Once per fight, fire three shots. Roll once for all of them; each hit deals d6 + Speed. Perfect Shot can be used together with Hawk Eye if it's available.

abilities.name: Small Friend
abilities.text: You start with a small cosmetic pet (3 HP max). It keeps you company but does not fight.

abilities.name: Bonded Companion
abilities.text: You have a second small animal friend — name it. The pet has 5 HP. At the end of each round it deals 2 damage to one enemy. At 0 HP it runs away and returns after the next rest.

trick.name: Pack Bite
trick.text: At the end of each round, your pet bites one enemy for 2 damage. At 0 HP it runs away and returns after the next rest.

abilities.name: Pack Tactics
abilities.text: Pet HP becomes 8 and its bite becomes 3 damage.

abilities.name: Focused Attack
abilities.text: Command your pet with your action: it bites for d6 damage, or grabs to make an enemy Stuck.

abilities.name: Wild Eyes
abilities.text: See through your pet's eyes, wherever it goes.

abilities.name: Split
abilities.text: When you take damage, split it with your pet — half to you, half to your friend.

abilities.name: Swap
abilities.text: You and your pet magically swap places in a flash of light.

abilities.name: Beast Mode
abilities.text: One of your pets grows HUGE for one fight — 10 HP and a 4-damage bite! When the fight ends, tap the Beast Mode chip in your tracker to shrink them back.

abilities.name: Blessed Hands
abilities.text: All spells add 2 HP to yourself or a touched ally. Say “Blessed Hands” out loud after each spell cast for the +2 heal.

abilities.name: Radiant Healer
abilities.text: All healing now works at range. Once per fight, Heal is a free action.

abilities.name: Great Blessing
abilities.text: Grant a player +2 heals for 3 turns, once per fight.

abilities.name: Quick Cast
abilities.text: Once per fight, cast a special spell as a Free Action.

abilities.name: Animal Shape
abilities.text: Transform into an animal of your choice (no flying). Free action.

abilities.name: Voice of the Wild
abilities.text: Roots — two enemies are Stuck. Bloom — flowers bloom and poison the air, two enemies Hurt. Or call an animal spirit (HP 5, attacks for 2 at the end of the round).

abilities.name: Wild Storm
abilities.text: Call a lightning storm — d6 to 3 enemies + Stuck. Healing rain heals 3 players d6. Roll Mind 13+ to keep the storm going another round.

abilities.name: Heart of the Grove
abilities.text: Voice of the Wild works twice per fight. Animal Shape can now use flying animals. Sacrifice your spirit animal to heal 3 players d6 + Mind.

abilities.name: Reactive Caster
abilities.text: Cast Dispel or Calm as a Reaction during an enemy turn to stop magic or mind-control.

abilities.name: Reverse Card
abilities.text: Reverse an enemy spell or attack to another target, including back to the attacker.

abilities.name: Mind's Eye Card
abilities.text: Tell if someone is telling the truth.

abilities.name: Undo Card
abilities.text: Reverse a catastrophic attack or moment.

abilities.name: Mirror Card
abilities.text: Change location with another — self, ally, or enemy.

abilities.name: Voice of Truth
abilities.text: Truth Card — once per adventure, speak one small true fact. If the GM agrees it is possible, it becomes true.

abilities.name: Fire Explosion
abilities.text: Hit all enemies around you for d6 fire damage.

abilities.name: Fire Armor
abilities.text: For the fight, enemies roll d20 to hit you with -2, and enemy melee attacks deal 2 damage back to the attacker.

abilities.name: Storm Caller
abilities.text: Charge your weapon with elemental energy. Hold it to the sky and say “I have the power!” Weapon attacks become ranged and hit 3 enemies — the first takes full dice damage, the rest take d6 + Mind.

abilities.name: Elemental Teleport
abilities.text: Teleport to a spot in line of sight. This activates Fire Explosion even if it's on cooldown.

abilities.name: Arcane Insight
abilities.text: Ask the GM one true question about an object, creature, place, or person.

abilities.name: Overcharge
abilities.text: Once per fight, before you roll, shout “Overcharge!” The next spell deals max damage on a hit.

abilities.name: Knowing Eye
abilities.text: You always know enemy info — HP, shields, weaknesses, and strengths.

abilities.name: Spell Master
abilities.text: Have up to 8 Ready Spells instead of 6. Once per adventure, recharge your spells.

spells.name: Zap
spells.text: Roll d20 + Mind against one foe. Deal d6 + Mind damage.

spells.name: Shield Bubble
spells.text: Block all damage from one attack on yourself or a friend.

spells.name: Sleep Dust
spells.text: One small enemy falls Asleep. Big monsters resist (13+).

spells.name: Light
spells.text: Make magical light, bright as a torch. Lasts the whole scene.

spells.name: Spark
spells.text: Ranged lightning. d20 + Mind to hit. Damage d6. Hits 3 targets.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.text: An invisible hand grabs small things, pushes buttons, unties knots, or fetches items. Lasts the scene.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.text: For one minute, magical things nearby glow blue to you.

spells.name: Featherfall
spells.text: You and friends fall slowly and safely from any height.

spells.name: Frostbolt
spells.text: Ice shard. d20 + Mind to hit. Damage d6 + Mind. Target is Stuck.

spells.name: Mirror Image
spells.text: Three copies appear. The next three attacks against you hit a copy instead.

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.text: You or a friend you touch becomes invisible until attacking or casting.

spells.name: Spider Climb
spells.text: You or a friend climbs walls and ceilings for the scene. No Speed roll needed.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.text: Hits up to 6 clustered enemies in a wide explosion. d20 + Mind. d6 + Mind to each. Careful near friends.

spells.name: Polymorph
spells.text: Turn one creature into a harmless animal for the scene. Big bosses resist with Might 13+.

spells.name: Wall of Stone
spells.text: Create a 10 ft long, 6 ft tall stone wall. Blocks enemies and attacks. Lasts the scene.

spells.name: Teleport
spells.text: Once per adventure, move the party somewhere you have been before.

spells.name: Heal
spells.text: Target yourself or an ally. Restore d6 + Mind HP.

spells.name: Animal Friend
spells.text: Chat with one beast for a minute. It stays kind and helpful.

spells.name: Bless
spells.text: One ally gains +2 to their next d20 roll.

spells.name: Calm
spells.text: Target one monster. Ends Frightened, rage, or combat for a minute.

spells.name: Touch of Death
spells.text: Spirit hands from the dead attack. d20 + Mind to hit, d6 damage + Hurt.

spells.name: Cure Sickness
spells.text: Touch a friend. Remove Hurt, poison, sickness, or curse.

spells.name: Speak with Plants
spells.text: Talk to plants and trees for a minute. They notice things walkers miss.

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.text: Pick a friend. Until they attack, enemies choose someone else if possible.

spells.name: Glow Lantern
spells.text: Holy symbol shines like a lantern. Undead in the light get -1 to attack rolls.

spells.name: Holy Fire
spells.text: Burning light falls from the sky on enemies. d6 + Mind damage + Stuck.

spells.name: Group Heal
spells.text: All nearby friends, including you, regain d6 HP.

spells.name: Warding Word
spells.text: One friend you can see takes -2 damage from hits for the fight.

spells.name: Talk to the Dead
spells.text: Ask a dead creature or skull up to 3 questions. Honest but maybe confused.

spells.name: Mend
spells.text: Touch a broken normal thing. It repairs itself. Not magic items.

spells.name: Revive
spells.text: Once per adventure, an Asleep / 0 HP friend returns to full HP.

spells.name: Summon Animal Friend
spells.text: A wild animal helps for the rest of the scene. Normal threat level.

spells.name: Dispel
spells.text: End one magical effect you can see: curse, illusion, spell, or magical lock.

spells.name: Sun's Embrace
spells.text: Once per adventure, friends regain all HP and lose Hurt and Stuck.

races.name: Human
races.lore: The most common folk in the world. What they lack in pointed ears or magical heritage they make up for in pure stubborn grit. A Human will try anything once — and twice if the first time was funny.
appearance: Every shade of skin, hair, and eyes

ability.name: Try Anything Once
ability.text: Once per rest, when you fail a d20 roll, re-roll the same thing and keep whichever result is better. Pick your moment.

races.name: Forest Elf
races.tagline: Quiet, ancient, friend to the green world.
races.lore: Forest Elves grow up in the deep woods and learn to walk between leaves without snapping a twig. They live far longer than humans and speak slowly, because they have plenty of time.
appearance: Skin in bark, leaf, or moonlight tones

ability.name: Forest's Friend
ability.text: You always move quietly through any natural place — woods, fields, rivers, gardens — with no roll needed to sneak outdoors. Animals tend to trust you.

races.name: Stoneling
races.tagline: Short, sturdy, born of mountain hearths.
races.lore: Stonelings live in mountain halls carved into living rock. About the size of a 9-year-old but built like a small barrel, they love to build things, eat hearty stews, and tell stories around a fire.
appearance: Can vary from 4 feet tall and broad to 8 feet tall and muscular
Earthy skin, copper, iron, or stone hair

ability.name: Stone Sense
ability.text: You see in the dark as well as you see in dim light (the world looks gray, but you see fine). Underground or near stone, touch a wall to sense which way is “out.”

races.name: Catfolk
races.tagline: Curious, clever, always landing on their feet.
races.lore: People with the heads, tails, and senses of cats. They walk on two legs with a cat's grace and a cat's curiosity, investigate anything that makes a noise, purr when happy, and have very strong opinions about birds.
appearance: Cat ears, eyes, whiskers, and a long balancing tail

ability.name: Always Land on Your Feet
ability.text: You never take damage from falling, no matter how high. +1 to Speed rolls for balance, climbing, or jumping. You see in dim light as well as anyone sees in bright light.

races.name: Sprite
races.tagline: Tiny, magical, full of mischief and light.
races.lore: About a foot tall — small enough to ride on a dog, big enough to talk back. Sprites think fast and talk faster, love sweets, jokes, and shiny things, and will swap your spoon for a flower and think it's the funniest thing ever.
appearance: Skin and hair that shimmer in unusual colors

ability.name: Fly and Flicker
ability.text: You can fly short distances (about as far as you could walk in a turn) and you glow enough to see by in the dark. For person-sized tasks, ride a friend's shoulder or fly close.

races.name: Lizardfolk
races.lore: From the warm marshes and river deltas, Lizardfolk have scaled skin, sharp teeth, and a steady, patient nature. They consider, then act — good friends to have when everyone else is panicking. They love sunshine, warm rocks, and fish.
appearance: Scaled skin in green, brown, gold, or blue

ability.name: Cold Blood
ability.text: You can hold your breath a really long time (10 minutes) and swim as fast as you run. Hot and cold places don't bother you. Bonus: heal 1 extra HP whenever you Rest in the sun.

races.name: Cloudkin
races.tagline: Sky-born, light as breath, dreamers all.
races.lore: From floating islands high above the world. Cloudkin are lighter than they look, their hair drifting in unfelt breezes. They are dreamers and musicians who tell stories about clouds and stars — and a little forgetful, because their thoughts drift.
appearance: Hair that moves with no wind

ability.name: Wind's Child
ability.text: When you fall, you fall slowly like a leaf and always land safely. You jump twice as far as normal, and once per Rest you can briefly walk on the wind for one round (across a gap, up a wall).

races.name: Foxfolk
races.lore: People with fox-like features who live by their wits. Every Foxfolk's grandparent is (supposedly) a famous trickster who outwitted a king. They love riddles, music, and a good deal. If a Foxfolk says they're being honest, they probably are — and probably about to do something clever.
appearance: Fox ears peeking through their hair and a fluffy tail
Cream-to-auburn skin and a fox-like face

ability.name: Silver Tongue
ability.text: Once per rest, when talking to a non-monster creature, you may ask one question they will answer truthfully — even if they didn't want to. (Not in combat, and not on creatures that hate you.)

trick.name: Get Behind Me
trick.text: Take a hit meant for a friend next to you. Big, grumpy, food-motivated, fiercely loyal.

trick.name: Takedown
trick.text: Pounce one enemy — it is Stuck until the end of its next turn. Can't sit still; sprints, then naps hard.

trick.name: Ember Breath
trick.text: Up to 2 close enemies take d4 and are Hurt. Tiny, vain, hoards shiny coins. Grows over the campaign!

trick.name: Shimmer Bubble
trick.text: Give a friend a bubble that blocks the next hit. Passive: magical things glow softly nearby.

trick.name: Screech
trick.text: One enemy is Frightened. Echo Sight (passive): the party can't be ambushed in darkness.

trick.name: Curl Up
trick.text: Block one hit meant for its hero. Always Watching (passive): the party can't be surprised.

trick.name: Curious Paws
trick.text: Find one hidden item, path, or switch.

trick.name: Night Eyes
trick.text: See in the dark through Hoot (passive). Hoot carries a message round-trip in one rest.

trick.name: Sky Lift
trick.text: Once per adventure, fly a hero somewhere in sight. Dive Tackle (Recharge): swoop and make one enemy Stuck.

trick.name: Distract
trick.text: One enemy's next attack misses. Clever Paws (passive): auto-opens small locks and ropes.

trick.name: Shell Wall
trick.text: Block a hit for a friend. Living Library (once per adventure): one true answer about history or magic.
